Package com.example.sudokubeta.model

Interface ISudokuModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
SudokuModel
public interface ISudokuModel
Interface defining core operations for a Sudoku model.

This contract provides methods to load and clear puzzles, query and modify cell values, verify placements, discover conflicts and compute candidates. Implementations are expected to use a fixed board size defined by SIZE.

  • Field Details

    • SIZE

      static final int SIZE
      Board size (number of rows and columns) for this Sudoku variant.

      All implementations should assume a square board of SIZE x SIZE.

      See Also:

  • Method Details

    • loadPuzzle

      void loadPuzzle(int[][] puzzle)
      Load the provided puzzle into the model.
      Parameters:
      puzzle - a two-dimensional int array with dimensions SIZE x SIZE; use 0 to represent empty cells

    • clearAll

      void clearAll()
      Clear the entire board, setting every cell to empty (0) and removing any fixed marks.

    • get

      int get(int row, int col)
      Get the value stored at the specified cell.
      Parameters:
      row - zero-based row index (0 .. SIZE-1)
      col - zero-based column index (0 .. SIZE-1)
      Returns:
      the value at the cell, or 0 if the cell is empty

    • isFixed

      boolean isFixed(int row, int col)
      Determine whether the cell at the given coordinates is fixed (part of the initial puzzle).
      Parameters:
      row - zero-based row index
      col - zero-based column index
      Returns:
      true if the cell is fixed and should not be edited by the player

    • set

      void set(int row, int col, int value)
      Set the value of a cell.
      Parameters:
      row - zero-based row index
      col - zero-based column index
      value - the value to place (use 0 to clear the cell)

    • isValidPlacement

      boolean isValidPlacement(int row, int col, int value)
      Check whether placing a value at the given position would be valid according to Sudoku constraints (no duplicates in the same row, column or block).
      Parameters:
      row - zero-based row index
      col - zero-based column index
      value - candidate value to test
      Returns:
      true if the placement is valid, false otherwise

    • findAllConflicts

      List<int[]> findAllConflicts()
      Find all cells that are currently involved in any rule violation (conflict).
      Returns:
      a list of int arrays where each element is a two-item array {row, col} identifying a conflicting cell; the list is empty if there are no conflicts

    • candidates

      List<Integer> candidates(int row, int col)
      Compute the valid candidate values for the specified empty cell.
      Parameters:
      row - zero-based row index
      col - zero-based column index
      Returns:
      a list of integers representing allowed values for the cell; returns an empty list if the cell is not empty or no candidates exist

    • firstEmptyCell

      int[] firstEmptyCell()
      Return the coordinates of the first empty cell found in row-major order.
      Returns:
      a two-element int array {row, col} for the first empty cell, or null if the board is full
